name: AI image generation
how: Neural networks on GPUs, large image-text datasets; ★ diffusion denoising (an image grown out of random noise step by step)
impact: Hundreds of millions of people make pictures by typing; ChatGPT alone drew 700 million images in a week in March 2025, and illustration and stock photography were upended.

name: Viral-vector vaccines
how: Harmless adenovirus shell carrying a gene, cell-culture bioreactors; ★ a virus used as a delivery vehicle for a foreign gene
impact: Over three billion COVID doses, mostly in poorer countries, cheap and fridge-stable; now also used against Ebola.

name: FPV attack drone
how: Quadcopter drone, video goggles, explosive charge, cheap radio; ★ none new
impact: Millions a year are built in Ukraine and Russia; by 2025 drones caused an estimated 70-80% of battlefield casualties, changing how land wars are fought.
why: A version of the quadcopter and military-drone cards, but cheap enough for every infantry squad, which changed who uses air power.

name: Remote work
how: Video calling, cloud data centres, laptops, home broadband
impact: Hundreds of millions of office workers moved part of their week home for good after 2020, reshaping cities, commuting and offices.
why: A practice like email rather than a device, and built entirely from cards already on the board; keep only if you count practices.

name: AI coding assistants
how: Large language models trained on public code, code editors; ★ none new
impact: By 2025 about half of professional programmers used one daily and over 80% used or planned to; software is now partly written by machines.
why: A version of the large-language-model card put to one job, but it changed how a whole profession works.

name: Inactivated COVID vaccines
how: Virus grown in cells and killed with chemicals
impact: About five billion doses, mostly in China and the Global South.
why: The century-old killed-virus vaccine method; no new assembly.

name: Home COVID self-test
how: Rapid test strip, antibodies, nasal swab
impact: Billions of tests used at home in 2020-2022.
why: The rapid test strip card aimed at a new virus; same job, same way.

name: AI answers in web search
how: Large language models, search engine index
impact: Shown to about two billion people a month inside Google search by 2025, it changed search from a list of links to a written answer.
why: Search engine plus large language model; huge reach, but both parts are already cards.

name: Grid-scale battery storage
how: Lithium-ion (iron-phosphate) cells in shipping containers, inverters, grid software
impact: About 270 GW installed by 2025, more than pumped hydro; in California and China batteries now shift solar power into the evening peak.
why: Lithium-ion batteries put somewhere new; it changed how grids work, but the parts and job are existing cards.

name: AI computing clusters
how: Graphics-processor chips, high-bandwidth memory, liquid cooling, fibre networks; ★ none new
impact: Gigawatt-scale buildings that train and run AI; their power demand is reshaping electricity grids.
why: A scaled-up cloud data centre; it changed how data centres are built and powered, but it may read as a near-duplicate.

name: 5G mobile networks
how: Mobile phone network, ★ massive multi-antenna beamforming
impact: Over two billion 5G subscriptions by 2025.
why: A faster version of the mobile-phone network, same job; first commercial launch was 2019.

name: Iron-phosphate car batteries
how: Lithium-ion battery with iron-phosphate cathode, cell-to-pack design
impact: About half of new electric cars by 2025.
why: A chemistry variant of the lithium-ion card, same job.

name: TOPCon solar cells
how: Photovoltaic cell with a tunnel-oxide passivated contact
impact: Most solar panels made worldwide by 2025.
why: An efficiency tweak to the photovoltaic-cell card.

name: Protein structure prediction
how: Deep learning, protein-structure databases; ★ none new
impact: Predicted shapes for 200 million proteins, used by over two million researchers; won the 2024 chemistry Nobel.
why: Reshaped structural biology, but it is a research tool, like the instruments you dropped.

name: Passkeys
how: Public-key encryption, phone fingerprint/face sensor, cloud sync
impact: Over a billion people had turned on at least one passkey by 2025; the start of the end of passwords.
why: Recent and still mid-adoption; also close to the public-key encryption card.

name: Long-range attack drones
how: Small piston engine, wing, satellite navigation, warhead
impact: Thousands a month launched at Ukrainian cities.
why: A cheap cruise missile; the cruise-missile and military-drone cards cover it.

name: Telemedicine
how: Video calling, electronic health records
impact: Became routine for hundreds of millions of patients during the pandemic.
why: Video calling put to a new job, same way.

name: Instant bank payments
how: Mobile payments, bank networks, QR codes
impact: Brazil's Pix reached 150 million users in four years.
why: A version of mobile payments; India's similar system dates from 2016.

name: Crop-spraying drones
how: Quadcopter drone, GPS, tank and nozzles
impact: About 250,000 in China alone, treating 178 million hectares in 2024; spreading across Asia and Latin America.
why: Quadcopter drones put to a new job; early versions existed before 2020 so the date is soft.

name: Phone earthquake warnings
how: Smartphone accelerometers, cloud servers, mobile networks; ★ crowd-sensed P-wave detection
impact: Built into Android phones in nearly a hundred countries, sending about 18 million alerts a month; seconds of warning for billions who never had any.
why: A service on phones people already carry; reach is huge but quakes that use it are rare.

name: Oral COVID antiviral pill
how: Protease inhibitor drug plus a booster; ★ none new
impact: Tens of millions of courses taken at home in the first days of infection, cutting hospital admissions for the old.
why: Used by tens of millions, not hundreds of millions, and its use has faded; a new drug, not a new assembly type.

name: Malaria vaccine
how: Protein-particle antigen, adjuvant; ★ none new
impact: Rolling out to millions of African children a year since 2024; malaria kills about 600,000 people a year.
why: Real and growing, but tens of millions of doses so far, not yet a proven reshaping; the Asimov deck has general vaccination.

name: Novel oral polio vaccine
how: Live weakened polio virus, genetically stabilised
impact: Over a billion doses given to stop vaccine-derived polio outbreaks.
why: A tweaked version of the Sabin vaccine card.

name: Post-quantum encryption
how: Public-key encryption, ★ lattice mathematics thought to resist quantum computers
impact: Turned on by default in major browsers in 2024; protects a large share of web traffic for billions of users.
why: Same job as public-key encryption done with new mathematics; invisible to users.

name: Satellite texting from phones
how: Ordinary phone radios, low-orbit satellites; ★ none new
impact: Hundreds of millions of phones can send an emergency message where there is no signal.
why: A version of the satellite-internet card reaching ordinary phones; changed who can call for help, but few have used it.

name: Naval strike drones
how: Small fast boat, satellite internet link, explosive charge
impact: Ukraine used them to drive Russia's Black Sea Fleet out of the western Black Sea.
why: A military drone put on water; reshaped one sea war, unproven elsewhere.

name: Over-the-counter hearing aids
how: Hearing aid, earbuds, phone hearing test
impact: Since 2022 sold without a prescription, and hundreds of millions of earbuds can now act as hearing aids.
why: The hearing-aid card in a new form; it changed who can get one, but it does the same job.

name: Exposure-notification apps
how: Smartphone, short-range wireless link, cloud
impact: Installed by hundreds of millions in 2020-21, then retired.
why: Short-lived and of disputed effect; no lasting use.

name: Lab-grown diamonds
how: Synthetic diamonds (chemical vapour deposition)
impact: Now about half of US engagement-ring diamonds.
why: The synthetic-diamond card (1955) in jewellery; no new assembly.

name: AI weather forecasting
how: Deep learning on decades of weather data; ★ none new
impact: Run operationally by Europe's main forecasting centre since 2025, faster and often more accurate than physics models.
why: Just went operational; whether it reshapes forecasting is not yet proven.

name: Wastewater virus surveillance
how: PCR (DNA copying), sewage sampling
impact: Became standard public-health monitoring in dozens of countries.
why: A monitoring practice invisible in daily life, built on the PCR card.

name: RSV vaccines and infant antibody
how: Stabilised protein vaccine; monoclonal antibody
impact: Protects tens of millions of older adults and newborns.
why: Vaccines and monoclonal antibodies are already cards; same job.

name: Glide-bomb kits
how: Precision-guided bomb, folding wings, satellite navigation
impact: Russia drops thousands a month on Ukrainian front lines.
why: A version of the precision-guided bomb card.

name: Commercial crewed spacecraft
how: Reusable rocket booster, capsule
impact: Carries astronauts to the space station since 2020.
why: Human spaceflight already on the board; a new operator, same job.

name: AI video generation
how: Diffusion models on video; ★ none new
impact: Tens of millions of users by 2025.
why: Not yet used by hundreds of millions; a version of AI image generation.

name: AI agents
how: Large language models, tool access, code execution
impact: Early adoption in software and office work in 2025.
why: Too new to judge; a version of large language models.

name: Gallium-nitride chargers
how: Gallium-nitride power transistors, ★ wide-bandgap semiconductor switching
impact: Hundreds of millions of small fast chargers.
why: A smaller phone charger; not a change in anyone's daily life.

name: Gene-editing cures
how: CRISPR gene editing applied to a patient's own blood stem cells
impact: First approved for sickle-cell disease in 2023; hundreds of patients treated.
why: Still a handful of patients; the CRISPR card covers the method.

name: Wolbachia mosquitoes
how: Mosquitoes infected with a bacterium that blocks dengue
impact: Released to protect about ten million people; trial cut dengue by 77%.
why: Below the decade's cut; still scaling up.

name: Twice-yearly HIV prevention shot
how: Long-acting capsid-inhibitor drug injection
impact: Approved 2025, rollout to two million people planned.
why: Approved this decade but not yet in wide use.

name: Mixed-reality headset
how: Displays, lenses, inside-out tracking cameras, motion sensors
impact: About 30 million standalone headsets sold.
why: A niche gaming device, not in most people's lives.

name: Item trackers
how: Short-range wireless link, ultra-wideband radio, crowdsourced phone network
impact: Tens of millions of tags attached to keys and luggage.
why: A niche convenience; the 2013 versions predate the decade.

name: Smart glasses
how: Camera, microphones, speakers, AI assistant in eyeglass frames
impact: A few million pairs sold.
why: Small and recent.

name: Space tourism
how: Reusable suborbital rocket, capsule
impact: A few hundred paying passengers.
why: A luxury for a few hundred people.

name: Cultivated meat
how: Animal cells grown in bioreactors
impact: On sale in a handful of restaurants.
why: Still essentially a lab product.

name: Sodium-ion batteries
how: Sodium-ion cells, hard carbon anodes
impact: Early use in a few Chinese cars and storage systems.
why: Barely past pilot production.

name: Perovskite tandem solar cells
how: Perovskite crystal layer on a silicon cell
impact: First small commercial panels.
why: Still in trials.

name: Humanoid robots
how: Electric actuators, cameras, AI control
impact: Pilot deployments in a few factories.
why: Still in trials.

name: Brain implants for paralysis
how: Electrode arrays, wireless chips
impact: A few dozen patients.
why: Still in clinical trials.

name: Electric air taxis
how: Battery-electric multirotor aircraft
impact: Not yet in regular passenger service outside trials.
why: Still in trials.

name: Direct air capture
how: Fans, chemical sorbents, heat
impact: Captures a few thousand tonnes of CO2 a year, a rounding error.
why: Pilot plants only.
